content_sections.heading: Kerala High Court Clerical Assistant Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Written Test & interview OR interview only Written Test (Objective Type): General Knowledge & Current affairs (60 marks), Basic Mathematics (20 marks), General English (20 marks). Total 100 marks. 1/4 mark deduction for incorrect answer. Interview (10 marks). Minimum 35% marks required for ranked list. Scribe facility available for differently abled candidates. Compensatory time of 20 minutes per hour for differently abled candidates.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 26-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of Kerala High Court to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Kerala High Court CLERICAL ASSISTANT recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the Kerala High Court CLERICAL ASSISTANT recruitment is 26 September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the CLERICAL ASSISTANT post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Plus Two or an equivalent examination from a recognized board or institution to be eligible for the CLERICAL ASSISTANT position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary for the CLERICAL ASSISTANT post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the CLERICAL ASSISTANT post will receive a salary in the pay scale of ₹25100 to ₹57900 per month.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the CLERICAL ASSISTANT post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the CLERICAL ASSISTANT post in the Kerala High Court recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is strictly online. Candidates need to apply through the official Kerala High Court recruitment portal.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applying to the CLERICAL ASSISTANT post?
faq.answer: The age limit varies for different categories, with specific birth date ranges provided for General, SC/ST, and OBC candidates. Age relaxation is also applicable for certain categories.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the Kerala High Court CLERICAL ASSISTANT recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is charged for any category of candidates applying for the CLERICAL ASSISTANT post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the CLERICAL ASSISTANT position?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves a Written Test and an interview, or an interview only, depending on the discretion of the High Court.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be downloaded from the Kerala High Court's official recruitment website. A direct link is provided in the Important Links section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. Can differently-abled candidates avail scribe facility?
faq.answer: Yes, scribe facility is available for differently-abled candidates, and they are also provided with compensatory time during the written examination.
